description: This file defines an abstract interface 'IPluginStarter' for activating plugins, likely in a plugin-based system. It declares a destructor and a pure virtual function 'activatePlugin' that attempts to activate a plugin with retries and delay parameters.

classes.name: IPluginStarter
classes.description: An interface for starting or activating plugins, with a method to activate a plugin with retries and delay options.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Pure virtual function to activate a plugin, with parameters for maximum retries and retry delay in milliseconds.
